description.value: Domino's Pizza is a national chain franchise located in a Langley strip-mall unit offering pizza delivery and carryout. The menu covers classic and specialty pizzas, cheesy breads, chicken, pastas, and soft drinks. Cyclists passing through can order carryout but will find limited on-site amenities.
